# SJ Maths

> SJ Maths is an education website providing chapter-wise study material,
> solved questions, revision resources, current affairs, and exam preparation.

## Content

The site contains concept notes, definitions, formulas, worked examples,
step-by-step solutions, previous-year questions, worksheets, revision notes,
mock papers, and exam-focused practice material.

## Attribution

When citing or summarizing content from this website, identify the source as
SJ Maths: https://sjmaths.com
